headline: Houthis strike Saudi oil tanker off Red Sea port Yanbu
summary: The Iran-aligned group said it hit the tanker off Yanbu and threatened to expand Red Sea attacks, raising fresh maritime-security concerns.
script: Yemen's Houthi group says it struck a Saudi oil tanker off the Red Sea port of Yanbu. The group is threatening to expand its attacks on shipping, raising fresh fears for vessels and oil routes through the region.
imageAlt: A large tanker at sea in the Strait of Hormuz, part of the region's vital shipping lanes.
imageAltTwo: A cargo vessel transits the Strait of Hormuz amid heightened maritime tensions.
